subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential/scope/config contract should be accepted?
rationale: The remaining work changes Google Chat credential storage, consent/scopes, event delivery, and access to non-mentioned Space messages; source review can prove the gap but cannot choose that security and product boundary.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Limit Google Chat To Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin on service-account mention-triggered webhooks and narrow this issue to thread reliability only.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold all-message ingestion until a shared Google Workspace consent, token, subscription, and admin-approval model exists.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a product/security boundary decision, and steipete is the current snapshot carrier and thread-support lander in the inspected history.
